chapter: Lu Barker and the Barbarin family
title: The Aunt Jemima remark and the caricature of Lu
summary: A customer called Lu Aunt Jemima and later left a caricature of her; Metcalf was furious, while Danny took the five dollars.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x:
They had a ticket ...(?)... And it looked like they would just punch my stubs all over, and I know I ain't ate that much, but they would keep punching it like I done ate a whole lot of food, you know. And every intermission, Koko would say, "Come on, Lu, let's take a rest." And we would eat, you know.

So one night, a guy came in there, and he said, "I want music, maestro, please. But don't let him sing it (speaking of Danny)." He said, "I want Aunt Jemima to sing it." [LAUGHS HEARTILY] So Metcalf got up, and Metcalf was going to start swinging at the man for calling me Aunt Jemima. Danny said, "Man, don't do that to the man; he gave me a five-dollar bill."
Oh, Metcalf was burning up! -- for him calling me Aunt Jemima. And the man drew that sketch, I've still got it now, you know, one of these comedies...
He's got the breasts and behind.
He put a big behind and the big breasts and everything. When I came to work that evening, it was in the show (?) for the Morton ...(?)... I was so mad. I said, "I
don't look like that! Where's that man?!" [LAUGHS] I wanted to beat the man up, see...

You had to calm me... He said, "You don't do that. You'll have a bad reputation." He said, "You should be proud to..." I didn't know nothin' about that, you know, a man drawing a picture of me looking like that...
Yeah. Every step in the game, I'd have to explain it. You know, that's show business.
Well, I'd get mad. You know, I'd want to fight. I ain't lettin' them tell me... And the agents and everything, they'll owe you money, and they have to hold it. So I just couldn't put up with that.
